name: Local SEO Lesson - Introduction to Rank and Rents
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
Short intro to the "rank and rent" model: build and rank a local lead-generation site, then rent the leads or the site to a local business. The track covers set up, ranking, pricing and pitching.

# Key points
- Expectation setting: a good supplementary income stream, not a path to very large monthly revenue.
- If a business already holds a top-5 spot, a rank-and-rent site can help it take more of the top 5 (example: a physiotherapy business in East Vancouver).

# How this applies to TAG clients
- TAG builds rankings on the clients' own domains and GBPs, not on rented sites, so this model is background knowledge only.
- The "more spots in the top 5" idea maps to TAG's approach of ranking both the GBP and dedicated city/service pages.
